messages:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: SLO breach on /streaming/generate (p99 4.6s, p95 1.2s) — INCIDENT-7123 opened
ops-bot: auto-annotated: top signal = contbatch tail latency, mixed sequence lengths, KV churn spike
priya: I'm on it. seeing p99 spike aligns with 30m ago. streaming stalls for some long-seq requests.
matt: I can take live. pinging julia for batcher insight. @julia can you join?
julia: here. grabbing recent scheduler logs and the batching metrics dashboard. link: https://dash.internal/r/contbatch/7123
priya: customer-impact: Carla from CS says 3 customers reported slow responses on chat streaming (low volume, high len). Carla, any extra details?
carla-cs: yes — two support tickets, one is enterprise with >50% streaming drop for long prompts. customers see partial tokens then stall.
ryan: quick triage: batch size median jumped from 4 -> 18 for hetero traffic, backlog on packer queue, preemption not firing due to config mismatch (qos weights).
matt: can we toggle packer max_batch_size or reduce batching window?
julia: propose: reduce batch_window_ms from 12 -> 6, enforce max_batch_size=8 for streaming route, and enable preemptive_shed on contbatch. small change, quick rollback plan ready.
priya: do it. I'll run the config toggle on canary nodes first. matt, please prepare rollback commands.
matt: rollback: run /bin/opsctl set contbatch batch_window_ms=12 && set max_batch_size=32 && disable preemptive_shed. have it ready.
ops-bot: deploy started on canary pool (canary-rt-2), diff: batching.window=6ms, batching.max_size=8, preemptive_shed=true
julia: logs from canary show reduced queue depth, p95 dropped from 0.9s -> 0.5s, p99 down from 4.6s -> 1.4s after ~90s.
priya: that's promising. roll to 20% of streaming capacity. monitor KV eviction rate and scheduling fairness metrics.
ryan: note: KV churn still high for very long seqs — if we see paging, we may need to route long requests to dedicated small-batch workers (longseq pool).
julia: enabling route rule: if seq_len > 4096 route -> longseq-pool, temporary. will stage after 10% roll completes.
carla-cs: telling customers we are mitigating; will update with ETA ~10m.
matt: 20% roll complete, metrics look stable. initiating 100% roll.
ops-bot: deploy to 100% started. change id: cb-deploy-7123-hedge
priya: alerting: p99 trending down at region level. keep an eye on tail jitter.
julia: post-roll checks: no increase in latency on short requests; cost delta minimal. preemptive_shed evictions = 0.8% (acceptable).
ryan: follow-up actions: 1) tune packer fairness weights to avoid oddpack starvation, 2) add route for longseq to longseq-pool, 3) add a regression test for mixed-seqlen packing, 4) schedule postmortem if any customer SLA hit confirmed.
carla-cs: two customers flagged as potentially impacted; prepping notifications if we confirm degraded window >5m.
priya: closing the on-call handoff: matt take primary for follow-up, julia and ryan will do the remediation items. I'll update the incident doc and set severity to sev3->mitigated.
matt: ack. adding notes to INCIDENT-7123 and will coordinate postmortem with eng-runtime.
ops-bot: incident INCIDENT-7123 status updated: mitigated -> monitoring (p95/p99 within SLO).
priya: thanks team. any remaining actions?
julia: I'll open a short RFC for packer fairness tuning and longseq routing.
ryan: putting a watch on KV eviction and cost impact for next 24h.
carla-cs: customers notified: initial update sent. will follow up if anything else. :thumbsup:
priya: great. handing off to matt. end of live triage.
